text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, was that towel handkerchief present 
by my pillow from you, Creek-san?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you noticed. Fufu, I left it there as 
a little surprise for you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's handmade, isn't it? It's themed 
around my racing outfit, with all those 
patterns and detailed embroidery sewn on. 
So, um, that's why—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Must have been tough getting everything 
ready.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No. Making it while wondering if you'd 
like it was super fun, you know~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I see. —Wait, no. That's not it. 
Look.
